artifacts.summary: Confirms both defects live (scope + EXTENSIONS_ROOT resolution), inventories 52 current sess_$(date sites (38 real offenders: 1 .sh + 37 .md under commands/skills/agents, 12 correctly-excluded illustrative-prose .md), and recommends reusing run-all.sh's core/manifest.json-probe pattern for dual-mode root resolution plus an added .md-scoped scan alongside the unchanged whole-tree .sh scan.

memory_candidates.content: agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh solves source-store-vs-deployed root resolution by probing for core/manifest.json inside the candidate '../../..' ancestor (present = source-store, absent = deployed fallback one level up from SCRIPT_DIR). This probe-based pattern is more robust than a fixed-depth '../../..' walk (which silently resolves to the wrong root when run from a deployed tree with a different directory depth) and should be reused by any other script in this file family needing the same dual-mode root resolution.
